instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Always import and apply CSS variables for theme colors. Use Tailwind standard dark: variants linked to class 'dark'.
2. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (kebab-case) for test automation.
3. Use direct, pragmatic Indian freight language (e.g., e-way bill verification, FASTag tolls, Lorry Receipt (LR), Proof of Delivery (POD), WhatsApp Driver Bot, GST Compliance).
4. Highlight the three AI human-in-the-loop states consistently using StatusTag (Teal for Handled by AI, Amber for Needs Approval, Red for Needs Human).
5. For images, use the Unsplash URLs supplied in design_guidelines.json, never dummy placeholder URLs.
6. Make sure dark mode is activated seamlessly without visual glitches, reading from localStorage or system preference.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or plain flat text cards.
Use 12px rounded corners everywhere per specification (rounded-xl).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do NOT use HTML select or native date inputs; use standard custom or shadcn components.
Ensure high contrast on dark surfaces with clear borders (#2A3A4B in dark theme).
